The '''Alliance''' was the name given to the combined forces of the [[Empire-in-exile]], the [[New Jedi Order]], and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], who allied in [[137 ABY]] in order to [[Second Imperial Civil War|bring down]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]]. Its members reorganized themselves as the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] after they won the war.
